notes:
- **Three kinds of mods.** Style mods only change how a page looks; boxed mods run in TRIF's sandbox and do only what you allow; free mods can do anything. Most of Tim's mods are now style or boxed.
- **TRIF asks for each site**, not every site at once. Block a site to keep TRIF away; sensitive sites, like email and banking, start blocked.
- **Safer agents.** A mod that can post or send for you waits for your OK, and a tab your agent ran code in can't post as you until it reloads.
- **Mods from outside your chat start off**, Tim's too, until you turn them on.
- **Every mod's code and history**, with Restore; export, import, and mods that break offer a fix.

[All of what's new in 0.3.0](https://github.com/acapellascience/trif/releases/tag/v0.3.0)
